name: @caotang/import-kanka
description: The Kanka reader for the Kanka import (#293): a JSON campaign export zip read into codex rows and their Research pages — module to codex type, tags and type as keywords, private entities kept manual, attributes and relationships as text, posts as sections, birth and death reminders as a lifespan, events and calendar reminders as a world-history index, and the gallery kept — over the shared zip reader and XHTML walker. Kanka is Commons Clause: read for format only, no code copied. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
